test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In the situation of liquidity trap, the speculative money demand function becomes __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**infinitely elastic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A liquidity trap** occurs when interest rates are so low that monetary policy becomes ineffective in stimulating economic growth.
 
• In such a situation, the speculative money demand function becomes** infinitely elastic** because people prefer to hold cash rather than invest in assets that offer low returns.
 
• This means that even if the central bank increases the money supply, it will not lead to an increase in investment or consumption because people will simply hoard the extra cash.
 
• Therefore, fiscal policy, such as government spending or tax cuts, may be more effective in boosting demand and stimulating economic activity.
 
• Option 1, unitary elastic, is incorrect because it implies that a small change in interest rates would lead to an equal change in the demand for money. This is not the case in a liquidity trap where people are indifferent to changes in interest rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Inelastic money demand function means that people are willing to hold a fixed amount of money regardless of changes in interest rates or income levels.
 
• Zero money demand function means that people do not want to hold any money and prefer to invest all their wealth in other assets. This is an extreme case and not relevant in practice.
 
• Infinitely elastic money demand function means that people are willing to hold any amount of money at a given interest rate. This is the case in a liquidity trap where people are willing to hold cash even at zero interest rates.
